from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmission(BaseModel):
    """Admission counts from one CDS report for a single university."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., Fall 2021")
    admitted_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Section C1: admitted first-time, first-year degree-seeking students")
    admitted_transfer: int | None = Field(description="Section D2: admitted degree-seeking transfer students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityAdmission]
